notes.title: Nominate Feathery Ears if you like it!
notes.notes: Since I have the option to make this announcement, might as well give it a shot- If you like this game, feel free to nominate it for Steam Awards!

notes.title: Balance Patch
notes.notes: After watching YT videos and seeing where people often got stuck, I made a few tweaks. I think this probably will be the last update, unless someone finds something that horribly breaks the game flow.

notes.title: Fixed Errors and added a small addition to the final cutscene in the game.
notes.notes: Just wanted to tie up at least 1 of the stories loose ends!
